entities.summary: Kim Sain or Kim Sa-in is a South Korean poet, literary critic, and professor of creative writing at Dongduk Women's University. Kim has been appointed as the 7th President of the LTI Korea in the Ministry of Culture, Sports, and Tourism of South Korea, which is an Undersecretary-level position.
